name.ja: エネミーコントローラー

requirement.en: During a turn you have not activated "Enemy Controller".

effect.en: ●Change the battle position of 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field. ●Send 1 monster from your field to the Graveyard. Then, take control of 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field that is not in Maximum Mode until the End Phase. This turn, that monster cannot attack.
